fusions.name: Coin Trick
fusions.desc: Flicks a cold iron coin that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Stunned] for 1 second. It has a 40% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Dust in the Eyes
fusions.desc: Flings iron filings in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to each enemy caught, with a 30% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Not What It Seemed
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Cheat the Reckoning
fusions.desc: Once every 240 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
